free_tier.stated: Turkey VPS SSD (A) at USD 8.49 per month, reduced from USD 16.99: 1 vCPU at 2 GHz guaranteed, 2 GB guaranteed RAM, 30 GB SSD RAID10, 1 Gbps port, 2 TB a month of traffic, 1 IPv4 and 4 IPv6, KVM with SolusVM, in Istanbul. The Georgia equivalent is USD 18.99 for the same shape and the B plans are USD 11.49 in Turkey and USD 24.99 in Georgia.
